TotalEnergies places IT and MongoDB at the heart of its energy transition TotalEnergies is a global energy company producing and supplying oil, biofuels, natural and green gases, and electricity from renewable sources. The group has placed sustainable development at the heart of its strategy and operations, with the dual goal of achieving carbon neutrality by 2050 and providing accessible energy to the huge number of people around the world who lack it. Modern IT is at the heart of the transition at TotalEnergies, whose ambitious plans require increasing amounts of data, computing, cybersecurity, and flexibility while remaining cost effective.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational, document, and context data behind TotalEnergies's monitoring and predictive-maintenance workflows.

data_flow: Operational events, telemetry, or transaction data are ingested into MongoDB Atlas, enriched or filtered where needed, retained for fast query access, and served to analytics, monitoring, or customer-facing workflows in near real time. Upstream and downstream integrations include APIs, data lake.
business_outcome: TotalEnergies places IT and MongoDB at the heart of its energy transition
metrics: Standardizing the information system With an IT budget of €1.4 billion, TotalEnergies already has significant computing power.
Its architecture includes 14,000 servers and a next-generation supercomputer called Pangea4, which processes 37,000 TB of data.
In fact, the group faces 16 million attacks per year, and 3,000 of them require intervention, so 6% of the IT budget is dedicated to this challenge.
The group has almost reached its target of 60% cloud migration, with 400 out of 900 applications already migrated.
On the user side, the company has also deployed an AI ​​assistant, to 30,000 employees, who use it daily—further accelerating development on MongoDB by streamlining coding, queries, and automation.
architecture_clues: The deployment is designed for multi-cloud flexibility.
Time series storage is used for high-volume timestamped data.
The deployment integrates with data lake.
evidence_quotes: “Over the years, we had to bring these businesses together, standardize all their information systems, and automate numerous processes,”
“We were used to managing large IT sites that took several years to build and implement,”
“And we had the time. Today, we are faced with much smaller but more numerous sites.”
“This gives us much greater agility and helps us integrate the sites quickly,”
